# S2 (amendment) - ABI regen architecture supplement

## Pipeline
The npm script export:abi in packages/contracts runs
"hardhat run scripts/export-abi.ts --no-compile": it reads the compiled
artifacts from packages/contracts/artifacts and writes
apps/frontend/lib/contracts/abis.generated.ts. File header states
"AUTO-GENERATED by packages/contracts/scripts/export-abi.ts - DO NOT EDIT BY
HAND" and names the regen command (it auto-runs on npm run compile).

## Change content (git diff vs HEAD: 106 insertions, 0 deletions)
Pure addition - no entry removed or altered. Added per inheritor ABI:
- platformRenounced() view fn in MOVIE_TICKET_ABI_FULL (L1034),
  TICKET_NFT_ABI_FULL (L4071), SUBSCRIPTION_MANAGER_ABI_FULL (L4907),
  PAY_PER_VIEW_ABI_FULL (L5359).
- renounceOwnership() entries in the same four (L1047/4135/4933/5395).
- NewOwnerCannotReceive error entries (from the out-of-scope F-DFLIX-1
  transferOwnership probe, picked up by the same regen - observed, not reviewed).

## Guard
apps/frontend/lib/contracts/abi-drift.test.ts (14 tests): per-contract
order- and length-sensitive deep equality between the generated consts and the
compiled artifact ABIs; fails closed on missing artifacts/entries; pins the
export-abi.ts CONTRACTS list to the guard CONTRACTS list (FIND-01, df13).
The guard is the authoritative check that this regen is not drift.

## Invariant
Frontend ABIs equal compiled artifact ABIs for every exported contract,
verified mechanically by the guard (14/14 at baseline and final).
